judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The live markup is Español with no lang attribute, inside . 'Español' is a Spanish word, the name of the target language in a language switcher. It is not an English proper name or vernacular term, so English speech synthesis mispronounces it. Marking such language-selector items with their own language is the standard H58 practice, and auditors routinely report missing lang here under 3.1.2. The finding is correct.
